alcohol.answer: easyJet allows alcohol in both cabin and hold baggage if it is in retail packaging, between 24% and 70% alcohol by volume, in containers up to 5 litres, with 5 litres in total per person. Alcohol bought in the airside departure lounge can go in the cabin unopened, in an airport shopping bag or your cabin bag. You may not drink your own alcohol on board.

sections.p: From two easyJet help pages, "Restricted and unusual items" and "Dangerous Goods & Prohibited Articles", read on 22 November 2026.

head: Question
easyJet rule
rows: More than 24% and not more than 70% alcohol by volume, in retail packaging
Allowed in the cabin if unopened and under 70% abv, in an airport shopping bag or your cabin bag
Forbidden unless bought on the aircraft; people found drinking their own alcohol may face prosecution

list: Not on these pages: a separate limit for drinks of 24% or less, such as wine and beer.

faq: How much alcohol can I take on easyJet?
Up to 5 litres in total per person for drinks between 24% and 70% abv in retail packaging, in cabin or hold baggage.
Can I drink my own duty-free alcohol on an easyJet flight?
No. easyJet forbids drinking any alcohol not bought on board and says offenders may be prosecuted.
